-- Now let me compute OMI for these traders and get the average
SELECT AVG(
    (o.order_metrics->>'mod_freq')::float / (1.0 - (o.order_metrics->>'cancel_pct')::float)
) as avg_omi
FROM trade_records t
JOIN traders tr ON t.tr_anchor = tr."TR_KEY"
JOIN corporate_events c ON t."REC_KEY" = c."REC_EVT"
JOIN market_conditions m ON c."REC_EVT" = m."REC_PIN"
JOIN sentiment_analytics sa ON m."REC_PIN" = sa."REC_SA"
JOIN order_behaviour o ON t."REC_KEY" = o."REC_NODE"
WHERE ABS((sa.sentiment_data->>'news_score')::float - (sa.sentiment_data->>'soc_sent')::float) > 1.0
  AND (tr.trader_fin_data->>'risk_lvl') = 'Aggressive';

-- Average OMI per trader first, then average across traders
SELECT AVG(trader_avg_omi) as avg_omi_per_trader
FROM (
    SELECT tr."TR_KEY", 
           AVG(
               (o.order_metrics->>'mod_freq')::float / NULLIF(1.0 - (o.order_metrics->>'cancel_pct')::float, 0)
           ) as trader_avg_omi
    FROM trade_records t
    JOIN traders tr ON t.tr_anchor = tr."TR_KEY"
    JOIN corporate_events c ON t."REC_KEY" = c."REC_EVT"
    JOIN market_conditions m ON c."REC_EVT" = m."REC_PIN"
    JOIN sentiment_analytics sa ON m."REC_PIN" = sa."REC_SA"
    JOIN order_behaviour o ON t."REC_KEY" = o."REC_NODE"
    WHERE ABS((sa.sentiment_data->>'news_score')::float - (sa.sentiment_data->>'soc_sent')::float) > 1.0
      AND (tr.trader_fin_data->>'risk_lvl') = 'Aggressive'
    GROUP BY tr."TR_KEY"
) sub;
